items.name: ab-layer-crossfade
items.title: A/B Layer Ping-Pong
items.description: Two stacked layers alternate so any change crossfades, however fast you move between rows.

items.name: analytic-disc-picking
items.title: Analytic Disc Picking
items.description: Hit-test camera-facing discs by intersecting the pointer ray with their plane. Exact, allocation-free, and correct for shader billboards.

items.name: antialiased-disc-fragment
items.title: Anti-Aliased Point Discs
items.description: A phyllotaxis field of dots that stay the same weight at every pixel ratio, with no MSAA and no texture.

items.name: asymmetric-stagger
items.title: Asymmetric In/Out Staggers
items.description: A list that arrives item by item after a hold and leaves twice as fast, from the last row backwards.

items.name: asymmetric-typewriter
items.title: Asymmetric Typewriter
items.description: Rotating phrases that delete at twice the speed they type, with a beat of nothing at the empty string.

items.name: auto-advance-filmstrip
items.title: Auto-Advance Filmstrip
items.description: A centred strip that steps one panel every few seconds, neighbours dimmed and shrunk, on one CSS transition.

items.name: banded-scrollspy-rail
items.title: Banded Scrollspy Rail
items.description: A tick rail whose active mark widens as a section crosses a 7% band through the middle of the screen.

items.name: batched-blur-reveal
items.title: Batched Blur Reveal
items.description: Cards that enter together focus in as one staggered group instead of arriving as a slab.

items.name: bayer-plasma-hero
items.title: Bayer-Quantised Plasma
items.description: An iterated domain-warped plasma crushed to eleven grey levels, so the hero reads as a dot-matrix proof.

items.name: bayer8-ordered-dither
items.title: Bit-Math Bayer8 Dither
items.description: A smooth gradient crushed to five levels through an 8x8 ordered matrix derived from six integer ops.

items.name: blend-difference-cursor
items.title: Blend-Difference Cursor
items.description: A white dot in difference blend mode inverts whatever it crosses, growing 16 to 44 to 150px on hover.

items.name: browser-chrome-frame
items.title: Browser Chrome Frame
items.description: A macOS window frame with hover-revealed traffic lights and an address pill whose check draws itself on copy.

items.name: burst-audio-sync
items.title: Chord-Synced Particle Burst
items.description: Fires an arpeggio and its visual flares off one schedule, so each flash lands on its own note.

items.name: canvas-handoff-transition
items.title: Canvas Handoff Transition
items.description: The live WebGL canvas is handed to the next page and flies to its new slot, instead of being destroyed and rebuilt.

items.name: capture-phase-click-swallow
items.title: Capture-Phase Click Swallow
items.description: Cancels the single click a finished drag would fire, in the capture phase, without eating the next real click or keyboard activation.

items.name: char-stagger-scale-up
items.title: Char Stagger Then Scale-Up
items.description: Characters resolve left to right, then the whole word scales up with an overshoot as the last one lands.

items.name: clip-path-variable-tween
items.title: CSS Variable Clip-Path Tween
items.description: One tweened custom property drives every clip-path on the panel, and reversing the timeline is the exit.

items.name: compound-group-hover
items.title: Compound Group Hover Card
items.description: One hover drives four changes on three elements, each with its own duration and curve. Keyboard gets all four.

items.name: conic-property-border
items.title: Conic @property Border
items.description: A gradient ring that rotates around a rounded box. Two highlights chase each other; no JavaScript runs.

items.name: container-animation-reveals
items.title: One Reveal Engine, Two Axes
items.description: The same staggered line reveal fires for vertical sections and for panels on a horizontal track.

items.name: converging-flow-steps
items.title: Converging Flow Steps
items.description: A process diagram that closes from both ends while the connectors pop in a third of the way through.

items.name: converging-scrub-words
items.title: Converging Headline Words
items.description: Headline words slide in from opposite margins and lock into a sentence, pinned to scroll position.

items.name: cpu-mirror-picking
items.title: Raycaster-Free Hover Picking
items.description: Run the GPU's transform again on the CPU and hit-test the result. No raycaster, no rect reads.

items.name: css-var-stagger-reveal
items.title: CSS Variable Stagger Reveal
items.description: Groups reveal as they enter their scroll container; the stagger delay is a CSS calc over an index the JS writes once.

items.name: cursor-clip-path-mask
items.title: Cursor Clip-Path Mask
items.description: A disc of a second layer follows the pointer; hovering the trigger grows it until it covers the panel.

items.name: cursor-reactive-shader-glow
items.title: Cursor-Reactive Shader Glow
items.description: A warped-noise atmosphere with a light that trails the cursor, held under a hard luminance ceiling so copy stays readable.

items.name: cursor-repulsion-burst
items.title: Cursor Repulsion Burst
items.description: An orbiting particle field the pointer pushes out of the way, and a press detonates into a shock wave with a heat band.

items.name: cylinder-dot-score
items.title: Dot-Cloud Score Cylinder
items.description: Two counter-rotating cylinders of dots — rings, bar lines, notes — drawn from one buffer with no depth buffer.

items.name: cylinder-gallery
items.title: Cylinder Gallery Drum
items.description: Nineteen planes wrapped around a drum in the vertex shader, spun by wheel or scroll, focus falling off from centre.

items.name: dataset-parallax
items.title: Dataset-Driven Parallax
items.description: Layers drift at a rate written on the element itself, over the widest possible scroll window.

items.name: delayed-unmount-loader
items.title: Delayed-Unmount Loader
items.description: A loading overlay that stays mounted 600ms past the signal so its fade can actually play before it leaves.

items.name: depth-pulse-travelling-wave
items.title: Depth Fade And Travelling Pulse
items.description: A dot lattice on an arc: z drives alpha and point size together, and a per-column phase sweeps the pulse across the field.

items.name: dither-trail-image-reveal
items.title: Dither Trail Image Reveal
items.description: A dimmed image restored through a trail of Bayer-thresholded blocks that smear in the direction the pointer moved.

items.name: domain-warped-fbm
items.title: Domain-Warped FBM Fog
items.description: Slow, low-contrast fog that flows rather than fades, with a faint light that trails the cursor.

items.name: dotted-notepad-surface
items.title: Dotted Notepad Surface
items.description: A tiled dot grid that dissolves at the panel edges, with a hard-stopped folded corner.

items.name: drag-deadzone-capture
items.title: Drag with a Dead Zone and Pointer Capture
items.description: Captures the pointer on press but only commits to a drag past a distance threshold, so a shaky click stays a click.

items.name: drag-marquee
items.title: Drag Marquee
items.description: An endless row that drifts, takes a drag and a throw, and scatters its cards while your hand is down.

items.name: drag-throw-scroll
items.title: Drag-Throw Scroll
items.description: Grab the page and pull it; let go mid-move and it coasts on, decaying, as far as the flick earned.

items.name: drag-to-pin-progress
items.title: Drag Mapped To Pin Progress
items.description: Drag a pinned horizontal strip and it moves exactly one pixel per pixel, then throws and settles.

items.name: drifting-smoke-layers
items.title: Drifting Smoke Layers
items.description: Slow volumetric fog built from blurred radial gradients on three coprime cycles. No texture, no canvas.

items.name: dual-canvas-z-split
items.title: Dual-Canvas Depth Split
items.description: One particle field rendered twice with the depth sign flipped, so the text sits inside the field rather than on top of it.

items.name: dual-direction-scrub-entrance
items.title: Dual-Direction Scrub Entrance
items.description: Copy rises while a panel slides in from the side, both on one scrub with 600ms of lag.

items.name: eased-number-counter
items.title: Eased Number Counter
items.description: A statistic that counts up on an eased curve and settles on its exact final figure without shifting the layout.

items.name: exit-warp-navigation
items.title: Exit Warp Before Navigate
items.description: A ring of cards tears itself apart and rushes past the camera, and only then does the route change.

items.name: font-safe-text-split
items.title: Font-Safe Text Splitting
items.description: Line splitting gated on document.fonts.ready, re-split on late fonts and on width change, debounced.

items.name: fov-derived-row-step
items.title: FOV-Derived Row Spacing
items.description: A row whose item spacing is solved from a field of view and a camera distance, so it spans the frame exactly at any size.

items.name: fractional-render-scale
items.title: Fractional Render Scale
items.description: A field rendered into a backing store 0.6x its box — 36% of the fragments — with a grid measured in texels so the upscale never shows.

items.name: fullscreen-triangle-pass
items.title: Fullscreen Triangle Pass
items.description: One 3-vertex triangle covers the viewport and runs your fragment shader. No three, no ogl, no seam.

items.name: gpu-bezier-burst
items.title: GPU Cubic-Bezier Burst
items.description: Rings of dots that burst on click, every particle solving its own cubic-bezier easing in the vertex shader.

items.name: gsap-cursor-follower
items.title: GSAP Cursor Follower
items.description: A puck that replaces the arrow inside a panel, trailing 0.4s behind and swelling to a label over targets.

items.name: height-first-media-stage
items.title: Height-First Media Stage
items.description: A media stage sized from its height, with the width derived from the ratio, cross-fading layers and a caption that replays per index.

items.name: hinged-container-intro
items.title: Hinged Container Intro
items.description: The page body swings up from below the fold, hinged on its own bottom edge, with captions following it in.

items.name: hover-list-image-trail
items.title: Hover List Image Trail
items.description: Hovering a row stacks a plate into a column that follows the pointer; the oldest is culled past twenty.

items.name: hover-prefetch-wipe
items.title: Prefetch-On-Hover Wipe
items.description: Warms the next page on hover, wipes the screen on click, and navigates once the wipe has actually covered.

items.name: idle-gated-page-states
items.title: Idle-Gated Page States
items.description: A page entrance that will not start until a floor delay has elapsed and the main thread has reported itself idle.

items.name: instanced-quad-particles
items.title: Instanced Quad Particles
items.description: Up to 1800 drifting particles in one draw call — quads rather than point sprites, so each one has its own size, spin and shape.

items.name: inverse-scroll-scale
items.title: Inverse Scroll Scale
items.description: Media enters oversized at 1.25x and settles to exactly 1.0 as it rises through the first 60% of the scroller.

items.name: io-reveal-lite
items.title: IntersectionObserver Reveal
items.description: One element, one fade-and-rise on entry, no stylesheet and no library — with a single observer shared across every instance.

items.name: keyframe-param-object
items.title: Single Param Object Timeline
items.description: One plain object holds every animated value; the scroll story is a table of keyframes anchored to real sections.

items.name: knockout-zoom-pin
items.title: Knockout Zoom Pin
items.description: A word the size of the screen shrinks into a headline as you scroll, with the scene showing through its letters.

items.name: layout-lerp-scalar
items.title: Layout Lerp Scalar
items.description: Row, stack, drum and fan are one placement function of seven numbers. Switching layout is a tween over an object.

items.name: lenis-gsap-ticker
items.title: Lenis On The GSAP Ticker
items.description: Smooth scroll and ScrollTrigger on one clock, with the lag-smoothing line everyone omits.

items.name: looping-scroll-cue
items.title: Looping Scroll Cue
items.description: The hairline that dives down a hero. One keyframe pair, a hard ease, and a seamless loop.

items.name: lottie-ratio-poster
items.title: Lottie Ratio Poster
items.description: Reserves the box, holds a drawn poster, fetches the JSON only in view, then corrects the ratio from the animation's own w and h.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Pointer Button
items.description: A button that leans toward the cursor and springs back, with the label leading the box.

items.name: manufactured-scroll-range
items.title: Manufactured Scroll Range
items.description: An empty box N screens tall turns a one-screen scene into a scrollable sequence, with progress as a CSS variable and the index as state.

items.name: matchmedia-layout-teardown
items.title: matchMedia Layout Teardown
items.description: Two layouts behind one gsap.matchMedia block. Cross the breakpoint and the desktop branch reverts itself.

items.name: mixed-scrub-depth-layers
items.title: Mixed Scrub Depth Layers
items.description: Layers separate while you scroll and converge when you stop, because each depth has its own scrub.

items.name: morphsvg-letter-scramble
items.title: Letter Scramble
items.description: A word assembles out of noise — each character flips through wrong glyphs, decelerating onto the right one.

items.name: multipass-offscreen-composite
items.title: Multipass Offscreen Composite
items.description: Four passes into two render targets — ramp, additive fills, half-size bloom — and one composite that writes the canvas once.

items.name: nav-dot-wave
items.title: Nav Dot Wave
items.description: Nav dots that lift in sequence. The index is an inline custom property; CSS derives the delay.

items.name: ndc-mouse-bulge
items.title: In-Shader Mouse Bulge
items.description: A soft lens that follows the cursor, measured by projecting every vertex to screen space instead of raycasting.

items.name: nested-splittext-restore
items.title: Nested Split With True Restore
items.description: Splits rich markup into masked lines and restores the original innerHTML byte-for-byte on teardown.

items.name: orbit-ring-points
items.title: Single-Draw Orbit Rings
items.description: Concentric rings of dots, one bright marker travelling each ring, all of it in a single draw call.

items.name: page-reveal-overlay
items.title: Key-Replayed Page Reveal
items.description: An opaque overlay that fades away on every route change, replayed by nothing more than a changed React key.

items.name: panel-wipe-preloader
items.title: Staggered Panel Wipe
items.description: An eased 0-100 counter, a word list and a five-column wipe, all on one timeline so they cannot drift.

items.name: pause-dont-unmount
items.title: Pause, Don't Unmount
items.description: React 19's Activity hides a WebGL scene without losing its state. Effects still tear down, so the GL context is genuinely released.

items.name: percent-slide-carousel
items.title: Percent Slide Carousel
items.description: A flex track translated by -100% per slide. One CSS transition, no measurement, no library.

items.name: perspective-coverflow-scroller
items.title: Perspective Coverflow Scroller
items.description: Panels turn away from the centre in real 3D as you scroll a native container — no tween, no loop.

items.name: pinned-horizontal-track
items.title: Pinned Horizontal Track
items.description: A section pins while a strip of panels slides sideways, one scroll pixel per track pixel.

items.name: pointer-palette-sampling
items.title: Pointer Palette Sampling
items.description: Point at the artwork and it names the colour — a clamped pixel read snapped to the nearest palette entry.

items.name: pointer-var-gradient
items.title: Pointer-Variable Gradient
items.description: A soft glow tracks the pointer through two CSS custom properties. No rAF, no tween, no string rebuilding.

items.name: pooled-image-trail
items.title: Pooled Cursor Image Trail
items.description: Tiles drop behind the cursor from a fixed ring of 22 reused nodes, one every 130px of travel.

items.name: prescatter-horizontal-gallery
items.title: Pre-Scatter Horizontal Gallery
items.description: A pinned strip where each item rests slightly off its slot, flies in from ahead and peels away behind.

items.name: proximity-snap-track
items.title: Proximity Snap Track
items.description: A horizontal rail of variable-width cards that snaps only when you stop near one, and never skips past two at once.

items.name: quickto-cursor-preview
items.title: quickTo Cursor Preview
items.description: A preview panel drifts a full second behind the pointer, driven by two reused quickTo tweens.

items.name: radial-mask-spotlight
items.title: Radial Mask Spotlight
items.description: A layer masked to a soft disc follows the pointer, with a flat core that makes it read as a beam.

items.name: radial-ripple-dot-cloud
items.title: Radial Ripple Dot Cloud
items.description: A dot field with a travelling wave running out of one off-centre point, its density drawn by hand as a B-spline.

items.name: realtime-cube-envmap
items.title: Realtime Cube EnvMap
items.description: A metal knot reflecting panels that are actually orbiting it, captured six faces at a time every other frame.

items.name: rekey-caption-replay
items.title: Re-Key Caption Replay
items.description: A caption block whose staggered entrance replays on every index change, restarted by a changed React key.

items.name: relaxed-seeded-scatter
items.title: Relaxed Seeded Scatter
items.description: Seeded angles around a ring, pushed apart until nothing collides. Ghost ticks mark where they started.

items.name: rotary-drag-carousel
items.title: Rotary Drag Carousel
items.description: A wheel of cards you grab and spin. Angular drag, projected inertia, and it always lands on a station.

items.name: safe-preloader
items.title: Preloader That Cannot Hang
items.description: An intro overlay with a hard ceiling, a minimum visible time and a once-per-session flag, so a stalled load cannot trap the page.

items.name: scroll-deform-wave
items.title: Scroll Deformation Wave
items.description: An image that ripples with scroll speed and bends the other way on the way back, from two sine terms.

items.name: scroll-scrubbed-video
items.title: Scroll-Scrubbed Video
items.description: The scroll-to-frame mapping a scrubbed hero actually needs: smoothing, a snap, a frame quantiser and a loop that parks itself.

items.name: scrub-char-color-reveal
items.title: Scrubbed Character Colour Reveal
items.description: A dim paragraph resolves character by character as it crosses the viewport, tied to scroll position not a clock.

items.name: scrub-timeline-spine
items.title: Scrub Timeline Spine
items.description: A rule that fills as you scroll, with entries alternating either side and reversing on the way back.

items.name: seamless-marquee
items.title: Pixels-Per-Second Marquee
items.description: A marquee whose duration is derived from measured width and a px/second speed, so every strip moves at the same rate.

items.name: self-parking-raf
items.title: Self-Parking RAF
items.description: An epsilon snap lets a damped value reach its target exactly, so the frame loop hits its exit test and dies.

items.name: slab-page-transition
items.title: Slab Page Transition
items.description: An opaque slab rises through the frame, the route changes under it, and it keeps going — nothing ever reverses.

items.name: slow-float-idle
items.title: Slow Idle Float
items.description: A 14px rise and fall over 5 seconds, on the independent translate property so hover transforms still work.

items.name: spring-lattice-field
items.title: Spring Lattice Field
items.description: A CPU damped-spring lattice uploaded as a texture each frame, displacing a procedural grid the cursor can push around.

items.name: spring-to-linear-easing
items.title: Spring To CSS linear()
items.description: Solves a spring once, samples it into a CSS linear() string, and runs the whole bounce on the compositor.

items.name: step-end-caret
items.title: Step-End Blinking Caret
items.description: A text caret that snaps on and off instead of fading, using step-end timing and an uneven blink rhythm.

items.name: stepped-film-grain
items.title: Stepped Film Grain
items.description: A transparent grain overlay whose pattern jumps twelve times a second instead of every frame, so it reads as film.

items.name: stroke-to-fill-hover
items.title: Stroke-To-Fill Hover Rows
items.description: An index of outlined type where the hovered row fills in solid, drops its stroke, and steps sideways.

items.name: superellipse-text-avoidance
items.title: Superellipse Text Avoidance
items.description: A particle field that flows around the headline, held off by a 6-norm superellipse fitted to the measured text box.

items.name: surface-sampled-particles
items.title: Area-Weighted Surface Particles
items.description: Any mesh becomes a particle shell of even density, assembling bottom-up, with orbit rings measured off the sampled silhouette.

items.name: text-target-particle-glyphs
items.title: Text-Target Particle Glyphs
items.description: A particle cloud gathers into a word rasterised from a font already on the page, written left to right, then lets it go.

items.name: throttled-scrub-state
items.title: Throttled Scrub To State
items.description: A scrubbed trigger fires 120x a second; a time, distance and frame gate turns that into a handful of React renders.

items.name: tweened-cursor-uniform
items.title: Tweened Cursor Uniform
items.description: A shader grid with a lens under the pointer, whose position is tweened into the uniform so it settles instead of chasing.

items.name: uv-cover-fit
items.title: Cover-Fit UV Maths
items.description: object-fit: cover for a textured quad, solved in UV space so the crop follows a frame that reshapes every frame.

items.name: velocity-afterimage-pass
items.title: Velocity Afterimage Pass
items.description: Marks that smear into a tail when the pointer moves fast and stay crisp when it slows, from two targets swapping roles.

items.name: velocity-deform-cards
items.title: Velocity-Deformed Cards
items.description: Cards skew, stretch and trail in proportion to scroll speed, then settle on their own with no easing curve anywhere.

items.name: vertex-cylinder-bend
items.title: Vertex Shader Cylinder Bend
items.description: A flat plane wrapped around a cylinder on the GPU, with the curvature living in a uniform you can animate.

items.name: web-audio-scheduler
items.title: Web Audio Scheduling Kit
items.description: A lookahead sequencer: a coarse timer queues beats onto the sample-accurate audio clock, so tempo never drifts.

items.name: wheel-accumulator-stepper
items.title: Wheel Accumulator Stepper
items.description: Wheel input normalised by deltaMode and accumulated to a threshold, so one flick of any device moves exactly one step.

items.name: wrapped-ring-offset
items.title: Shortest Signed Ring Offset
items.description: Ten dots on a ring, each showing its wrapped offset and the raw index difference it replaces.

items.name: wrapping-drum-carousel
items.title: Wrapping Drum Carousel
items.description: An endless carousel that reads as a rotating drum with no 3D at all — only x, scale and fading opacity.
